title: Big Hero Squad
description: Assemble a futuristic team of super-powered heroes—unleash energy beams and shield bursts against relentless robotic invaders.
controls: Drag to move your hero squad, auto-fire plasma blasts, and trigger ultimate abilities.

zh-CN.title: 超能英雄战队
zh-CN.description: 科幻热血动作超能英雄战队：集结高科技超能战士联手释放能量光束，粉碎机械军团入侵守护未来都市！
zh-CN.controls: 拖动控制超能英雄走位走射，积满能量释放大招消灭一波波机械敌人。
